mprn.description: Meter Point Reference Number (MRPN). A unique identifier for the point at which a meter is, has been or will be connected to the Gas Network

msn.description: The manufacturer's meter serial number as held on the physical meter currently installed on the supply point

current_supplier.description: A unique three character code used to identify the current supplier

meter_capacity.description: The amount of gas that can be passed through the meter in a given time period. This is the manufacturer's maximum value

meter_mechanism.description: The coded value of the description of the Meter Mechanism

meter_type.description: The type of meter installed at the supply point

meter_model.description: Model of meter installed at the supply point

meter_year_of_manufacture.description: The year of manufacture of the meter installed at the supply point

smp_status.description: The current status of the operability of the supply meter point

meter_installation_date.description: The date of when the meter was installed

meter_asset_manager_effective_date.description: The date of when the MAM became effective for the Supply Point

meter_asset_manager_id.description: An identification number for the registered MAM for the Supply Point

meter_asset_manager_name.description: The company name of the registered MAM for the Supply Point

service_effective_valid_from.description: The date of when the service becomes effective for the Supply Point

meter_asset_manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the supply point meter

dcc_service_flag_effective_from_date.description: The first inclusive calendar date for which the status of Data Communications Company (DCC) Service Flag applies

current_shipper.description: Name of the current Shipper assigned to the Supply Point

incoming_supplier_short_code.description: A unique three character code used to identify the Incoming Supplier

previous_supplier_short_code.description: Specifies the 3 digit unique Supplier Short Code for the previous Supplier

previous_supplier.description: Name of the last previous Supplier assigned to the Supply Point

current_supplier_effective_date.description: Date on which the current Supplier took over responsibility for the Supply Point

current_map_effective_from_date.description: Date on which the current MAP took over responsibility for the Supply Point

current_map_effective_to_date.description: Date on which the current MAP ends it's responsibility for the Supply Point

previous_map_short_code.description: Specifies the 3 character, unique short code for the previous MAP

previous_map_effective_from_date.description: Date on which the previous MAP took over responsibility for the Supply Point

previous_map_effective_to_date.description: Date on which the previous MAP ends it's responsibility for the Supply Point

incoming_map_short_code.description: Specifies the 3 character, unique short code for the incoming MAP

incoming_map_effective_from_date.description: Date on which the incoming MAP takes over responsibility for the Supply Point

previous_supplier_effective_from_date.description: Date on which the previous Supplier took over responsibility for the Supply Point

previous_supplier_effective_to_date.description: Date on which the previous Supplier ends it's responsibility for the Supply Point

incoming_supplier_effective_from_date.description: Date on which the incoming Supplier takes over responsibility for the Supply Point

previous_mam_short_code.description: Specifies the 3 character, unique short code for the previous MAM

previous_mam_effective_from_date.description: Date on which the previous MAM took over responsibility for the Supply Point

previous_mam_effective_to_date.description: Date on which the previous MAM ends it's responsibility for the Supply Point
